entries.name: narrow-both-gt-v3-errored#2
entries.script: [R1] `If(false,1L,3) > If(false,1L,2)` at tree v3 — BOTH operands Long-typed with Int VALUES. THE ROW THAT WOULD HAVE REFUTED THE READING: the ordering comes from ArithOp.impls(left.tpe.typeCode) (trees.scala:1075-1078) and both values are cast to it, so a value narrower than its static type fails with a ClassCastException. It throws, so the ordering IS reached through the static type.

entries.name: narrow-both-eq-checktype-v3-errored#14
entries.script: [R7] `If(false,1L,2) == If(false,1L,2)` at tree v3 — **THE CONTROL THAT FAILS DIFFERENTLY, and the point of its being here.** EQ never reaches the ordering table: its own Value.checkType site catches the narrow value first and raises `InterpreterException: Invalid type returned by evaluator`, where every row above raises `ClassCastException`. The eval tier grades refusals COARSELY, so this vector CANNOT state that difference — an implementation that fixed only EQ would go green here and stay wrong on the other eight. Read this row's role, not just its verdict.
